title: Version 1.39.0
body:
Version 1.39.0

August 21st, 2023

Added:

  • Added Speed Coil! (Currently forced in stud shop)
  • New permissions UI
  • Added more meteor locations

Changes:

  • Temporarily disabled auto-trust for friends, due to security concerns
  • More ore spawns per vein
  • Increased amount of rocks in certain regions
  • Kelp is now far easier to find!
  • Various meteor locations are now easier to reach
  • Buffed Willow
  • Buffed Living Axe
  • Buffed Emberbane against Magma Trees

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed mobile having the option to play vertical

Version 1.39.1

August 21st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed grabby grabber getting stuck when filling in schematics
  • Fixed xbox not being able to select the trust/block buttons

Version 1.39.2

August 21st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed stats on Living Axe showing the wrong numbers
  • Fixed Kelp and Clay not spawning

Version 1.39.3

August 21st, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Grabby Grabber again

Version 1.39.4

August 22nd, 2023

Changed:

  • Removed ocean meteor crash site

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Dragging error from lack of PrimaryPart

Version 1.39.5

August 22nd, 2023

Added:

  • (Mysterious Monday) - Added "In.. Co.." and "Fu.. Co.."
  • Directional signs placed around the map

Changed:

  • Spherical Objects (Small Bomb, Large Bomb, Meteor Core) now have flat sides
  • "Explosive Needed" signs redesigned

Bug Fixes:

  • Mike's Mine Vinyl Rock now works (missing primary part)
  • Blocking no longer extends into the caves
